lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Teacher.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Please be honest.
About what?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: When you were in school,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: what kind of student were you?
Why do you ask all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Me and the others were talking about you,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: and I got curious, hehe.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I figured that you were a bit of a troublemaker,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: in light of how good-looking you are.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I can envision you wearing your uniform slightly askew

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: and hanging out with all the pretty girls.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: No way.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Teacher is a renowned military officer with a prestigious reputation.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: That means he was almost certainly at the top of his class.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Of course, there are some students who excel in their studies even while having a good time.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: However, considering Teacher's personality,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I don't think that's the case.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Maybe he was just an ordinary student

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: who liked to eat and sleep?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Is that your definition of ordinary?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Doing things in moderation, but not overdoing it:

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: attending class,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: eating and enjoying some leisure time.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Perfectly ordinary, like me! Haha.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I'd say eating and leisure time are more important for you, Rei.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: H ye!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Hehehehe.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Even your typos are cute.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: what kind of student were you, Teacher?
I don't remember much about my student days.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Huh?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Really?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Is it a sore subject?
No, it's not that.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Oh,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: well that's good.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Teacher.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: How about this then?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: What kind of student do you think you were?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Yeah, you can tell us that!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: If you don't remember, take an educated guess.
When I was a student...
Maybe I was a little bit of a troublemaker, hehe.
I was well-behaved and focused on my studies.
There was absolutely nothing noteworthy about me.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I knew it!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: You don't seem like the type who would blend into the crowd.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: You're well aware of the effect you have on ladies.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: That's a bit unexpected.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Given your current position,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I would have thought you'd have been diligent in your studies.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Wow, you're so lucky.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: That means you were a natural at studying and could afford to have fun at the same time.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: No way!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: You're pulling our legs.
Haha, keep in mind that I'm only guessing here.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Anyway, I won the bet,

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: so you owe me a parfait, Zwei, Rei.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: How can you consider that a win?

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: We have no idea if that's what Teacher was really like.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Of course that's what he was like!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: He just admitted it to us.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Weird.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I thought for sure he would have been an ordinary student.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: You and I are the same when it comes to that.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Ugh, no fun at all.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Why would you imagine your past self as someone so boring?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: What's the point of living if all you do is study?

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Right!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: You've got to at least sleep a bit in class,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: and eat some good snacks to make memories.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: That's why he went on to become a Commander,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: and our teacher.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Oh yeah, I guess you're right, hehe.
Haha, keep in mind that I'm only guessing here.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Anyway, I won the bet,

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: so you both owe me a parfait.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: How can you consider that a win?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: We have no idea if that's what Teacher was really like.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Of course that's what he was like.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: He just admitted it to us.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Weird.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I thought for sure he would have been an ordinary student.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Hahaha!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: I knew it!

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: The most ordinary students are the happiest.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Sleep whenever you're tired.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Eat whenever you're hungry.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Study whenever it crosses your mind.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: That's hardly what I'd call ordinary.

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: At most, maybe he was somewhat ordinary in his study habits.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: No no no.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: That's just plain ol' boring.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: If he was a normal student, he would have had a few girlfriends here and there.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I guess it depends on how you define "ordinary"...
Haha, keep in mind that I'm only guessing here.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Anyway, I won the bet,

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: so I'm gonna order a whole bunch of parfaits.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: How can you consider that a win?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: We have no idea if that's what Teacher was really like.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Of course it was.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Teacher just said as much.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Aw man... my money...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Oh well.
Um... hello?

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Oh, jeez!

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: I almost forgot that you were here, Teacher.

lines.speaker: ein
lines.text: Sorry about that. Thanks for all the help!

lines.speaker: zwei
lines.text: Ein, Rei, let's go talk in our own group chat.

lines.speaker: rei
lines.text: Hehe, sure.
For some reason, I feel a bit sad at being left out...
